[{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Hey there, do you have a moment? I really need someone to talk to."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Of course, Kelly! What's going on?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I've been feeling really overwhelmed at my internship. It's starting to feel like too much."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm sorry to hear that. What about it is overwhelming you?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It's just the workload is intense, and I feel like I'm constantly behind. It's affecting my confidence."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds incredibly tough. It's understandable to feel that way with so much on your plate."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, and on top of that, I'm still dealing with school pressures and everything else. It just feels like I'm barely keeping it together."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Managing both grad school and an internship is incredibly challenging. How have you been coping so far?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Honestly, not very well. My relationship with Matthew is also strained because of everything."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Navigating personal and professional pressures simultaneously can be so hard. Have you been able to talk to Matthew about this?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"We had a heart-to-heart recently, but I still feel like I'm not fully present with him. It feels unfair to him."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's great that you two talked. It's okay to feel this way, though. You're clearly trying to juggle a lot at once."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thanks, I appreciate you saying that. I just keep thinking about quitting the internship, but then I feel guilty for giving up."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Leaving something that's overwhelming isn't giving up. It's about making choices for your mental health. Have you weighed the pros and cons?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I have, but fear kicks in. I don't want to miss out on opportunities, yet I'm scared of burning out."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's perfectly normal to feel conflicted. Perhaps you could discuss your workload with your supervisor to see if there are adjustments that can be made?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I hadn't thought about that. Maybe I can propose a solution rather than keeping it all in."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's a proactive approach. You're not alone in this, and it's okay to seek support both at work and in your personal life."}]
</quoted_conversation_context>

I'm feeling a bit all over the place right now.\\nsupporter: That sounds tough. It feels like everything is riding on these decisions and I’m scared.\\nsupporter: I can understand why that would feel overwhelming. It sounds like an important conversation. Are you worried about specific aspects of your future?\\nseeker: Yes, balancing grad school with our relationship is so hard. And with the internship offer and other pressures... How are you coping with that disappointment?\\nseeker: I thought it would help ease my financial burden, so now it adds to the pressure. I'm trying to focus on the positives, like my professor's praise, but it's hard.\\nsupporter: Remember, you've had some great achievements recently that are worth celebrating. Sometimes starting with small victories can help regain some control and focus. How did you feel when your professor praised your work?\\nseeker: It was definitely a confidence booster! For a moment, I felt like I was on the right path. But these doubts just keep creeping back in.\\nsupporter: It's completely normal for doubts to come and go. Progress isn't always linear, and that’s okay. Maybe focusing on setting small, achievable goals could help?\\nseeker: That's a good idea. I think I get caught up in wanting everything to be perfect. Maybe I need to let go of some of that control.\\nsupporter: Perfection can be a high bar to set for yourself. It's great that you're considering being more flexible. Is there one small change you could make this week?\\nseeker: Maybe I'll try setting aside specific time for Matthew and limiting my work time each day. I think he’d appreciate that.\\nsupporter: That sounds like a wonderful plan, very considerate of both your needs. How do you feel about trying that out?\\nseeker: It feels good to have a plan. I hope it helps balance things a bit more. Thank you for listening, I really needed this.\\nsupporter: I'm glad you're finding a direction that feels right for you. Remember, I'm here whenever you need to talk or just vent.
